## Buying as a non-resident
- Non-residents can own freehold property in South Africa on the same terms as residents, with no foreign-buyer quota.
- Funds brought in through an authorised dealer (with the deal receipt kept) can be repatriated on resale, together with net growth after Capital Gains Tax clearance, subject to the exchange control rules in force at the time.
- New homes sold by a VAT-registered developer (for example Sera Bella, Izinga Ridge) carry VAT in the price instead of transfer duty.
- Prices are in South African rand. Viewings can be held by video call, and offers are signed electronically.
